value.rationale: Two diameters are canonical maximally long shortcuts and introduce nontrivial pair interference on a rotationally homogeneous graph. Exact agreement of A- and D-optimal placements gives a reusable benchmark rather than a nominal reformulation, and balances yield a factor-two gain in the leading total-resistance reduction and an unbounded spanning-tree multiplicative advantage over adjacent diameters. Scope is clearly restricted.
